wildspellmobs.configuration.title: Wildspell Mobs
message.wildspellmobs.lich_soul_flees: The lich's soul flees to its phylactery. It will not stay dead.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.found.belo: The shard pulls toward its lich's phylactery, about %s blocks away, below you.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.found.abov: The shard pulls toward its lich's phylactery, about %s blocks away, above you.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.found.leve: The shard pulls toward its lich's phylactery, about %s blocks away, level with you.
item.wildspellmobs.frozen_phylactery.bou: A lich's soul is bound within.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.none: The shard lies still. The soul it was bound to is gone.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.elsewhere: The shard strains toward another world.
item.wildspellmobs.soulseeker.unbound: Bound to no soul. Its needle drifts.
message.wildspellmobs.phylactery_taken: The phylactery is torn from its altar. The lich will follow it anywhere.
message.wildspellmobs.phylactery_burned: The phylactery burns! The lich's last form rises from the flames.
message.wildspellmobs.lich_fallen: The lich is destroyed. Its hold on the caves is breaking.
message.wildspellmobs.crypt_cleansed: The crypt's cold lifts. The souls it held go free.
advancements.wildspellmobs.eternal_damna: Set a lich's phylactery down in the End, where its soul will wander the void forever
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_arrives: Something steps out of the sun's glare. It is smiling.
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_arrives_war: %s comes out of the glare again, slower this time. "You. I paid you once."
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_concedes: %s lowers his rays. "Enough! Put away your weapon and I will buy my life from you. Strike me again and you put out the sun."
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_concedes_wa: %s lowers his rays at once. "Again, then. Empty your hand and I pay again. Strike, and there is no more day."
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_warning: His light gutters. Strike him once more and the sun goes out over this world, for good: no more days, ever.
subtitle.wildspellmobs.apollo_warning: One more blow ends the day forever
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_steadies: His light steadies. The offer stands.
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_takes_silen: He takes your stillness for mercy.
message.wildspellmobs.apollo_spared: %s bows and climbs back into the sun. He will remember what he owes you.
message.wildspellmobs.sun_slain: The sun has gone out. It will not rise again over this world.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_arrives: A horn sounds across the night. Something has your scent.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_arrives_grie: A horn, low and broken. "You let my brother's light go out. Run."
message.wildspellmobs.diana_returns: The horn again. She has found your trail.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_joins: A horn sounds. The huntress has room for one more.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_caught: Diana has her quarry. The hunt goes on without you.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_yields: Diana lowers her bow. "The hunt is yours."
message.wildspellmobs.diana_yields_griev: Diana lowers her bow and weeps. "Go. It will not bring him back."
message.wildspellmobs.diana_dawn: The sky pales. Diana lowers her bow: you have outlasted the night.
message.wildspellmobs.diana_dawn_grievin: Dawn comes, and Diana lets you go. It is not you she grieves for.
message.wildspellmobs.wardens.fallen: A warden of the sun is dead. The sky's heat turns toward you. (%s of %s)
message.wildspellmobs.wardens.answered: The last of the sun's wardens you needed is dead. Climb high and look it in the eye. (%s of %s)
